title: West Coast Avengers #46 Marvel 1989 1st Appearance Great Lakes Avengers Byrne
conditionDescription: Multiple copies available; all in a similar Very Good range with clean glossy covers and light handling wear. Photos show one of the copies. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copies being sold.
descriptionText:
West Coast Avengers #46 (July 1989, Marvel Comics) -- KEY ISSUE: first appearance of the Great Lakes Avengers (Mr. Immortal, Big Bertha, Flatman, Doorman and Dinah Soar). John Byrne story and cover. Direct edition. Back cover carries a 1989 Schwinn BMX ad. Cover price 75c US.

Condition: Very Good. Cover clean and glossy with light handling wear. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
